main_through_platform.description: Continuous single long platform (~470m total length) running alongside the main ticket hall and station entrance.

north_bays.description: Terminal bay platforms situated on the north-west side of Platform 1 for terminating trains from London/Stevenage and Stansted.

south_bays.description: Terminal bay platforms situated on the south-west side of Platform 4 for terminating trains from Ipswich, Norwich, and London Liverpool Street.

island_platform.description: Island through platform on the eastern side across the running lines, accessed via the main covered footbridge and lifts.

7_to_8.notes: Same island platform; walk directly across (10-20 sec).

3_to_4.notes: Walk from north bay 3 along Platform 1 to Platform 4.

4_to_3.notes: Walk from Platform 4 along Platform 1 to north bay 3.

1_to_7.notes: Take covered footbridge stairs/lift across tracks to island platform 7.

7_to_1.notes: Take covered footbridge stairs/lift across tracks to main platform 1.

1_to_8.notes: Take covered footbridge stairs/lift across tracks to island platform 8.

8_to_1.notes: Take covered footbridge stairs/lift across tracks to main platform 1.

7_to_2.notes: Footbridge stairs from Plat 7 over to Plat 1, then into bay 2.

8_to_2.notes: Footbridge stairs from Plat 8 over to Plat 1, then into bay 2.

7_to_3.notes: Footbridge stairs from Plat 7 over to Plat 1, then into bay 3.

8_to_4.notes: Cross footbridge from Plat 8 down to main platform, walk south to Plat 4.

1_to_5.notes: Walk south along Platform 1 and 4 into south bay 5 (~350m).

morning_outbound.name: Situation A: North Bay 2 to Main Platform 1 (Level Walk)
morning_outbound.description: Step off Great Northern train in Bay 2, walk 30m straight onto adjacent main Platform 1 (no stairs/bridge).

morning_outbound.name: Situation B: North Bay 2 to South Platform 4 (Main Platform Walk)
morning_outbound.description: Walk out of Bay 2 south along the continuous main platform ~200m to Platform 4.

morning_outbound.name: Situation C: Island Platform 7 to Main Platform 1 (Footbridge)
morning_outbound.description: Alight Thameslink on Island 7, take covered footbridge stairs over tracks to Platform 1.

morning_outbound.name: Situation D: Island Platform 7 to South Platform 4 (Footbridge + Walk)
morning_outbound.description: Alight Thameslink on Island 7, cross footbridge down to main platform, walk south to Platform 4.

morning_outbound.name: Situation E: Main Platform 1 to Platform 4 (Level Walk)
morning_outbound.description: Alight Thameslink on Platform 1, walk south along the continuous platform to Platform 4.

evening_inbound.name: Situation 1: Island Platform 8 to Island Platform 7 (Instant Cross-Platform)
evening_inbound.description: Step off Cambridge North train on Plat 8, turn around on the same island platform to board Thameslink on Plat 7 (< 20s).

evening_inbound.name: Situation 2: Island Platform 8/7 to West North Bay 2 (Footbridge)
evening_inbound.description: Cross footbridge from Island 8/7 over to main side and into North Bay 2 for Great Northern departures.

evening_inbound.name: Situation 3: Main Platform 1 to North Bay 2 (Level Walk)
evening_inbound.description: Direct level walk from Platform 1 into adjacent Bay 2.

evening_inbound.name: Situation 4: South Bay 5 to North Bay 2 (Full Station Walk)
evening_inbound.description: Walk north along the full ~450m length of the main platform from South Bay 5 to North Bay 2.
